attested.notes: FROM-SCRATCH REDRAFT, replacing the patched draft that had reached seven passes. Written against writer-core, the legal-compliance overlay and the process_guide spec from editorial_task_entry, none of which the earlier patching passes had loaded. Prose is new throughout; the verified legal content was carried across deliberately and not re-derived: s131 21 days running from the notice and not the winding-up order, the Official Receiver's discretion to require a statement of affairs at all, no fixed 21-day petition service period with the 21 days belonging to a statutory demand, rule 6.14's three-business-day floor and 14-day ceiling, s85, s201, s214, s239 with the six-month and two-year connected-party lookbacks, Form 600, and the 2016 Rules replacing the final meeting. Three things the previous version never had: a Quick Answer that branches by where the reader actually stands (nothing started / resolution passed / petition served), which both earlier stranger reads had asked for; the two callout components this page class expects (Timeline Reality on the three-day floor inside the 14-day window, What Most Directors Miss on the s131 clock starting at the notice); and bold on decision-critical chunks at 6.2% density with every H2 covered, against a spec of 2-6% and a ceiling of 8% that the old page had never met. Writer-core's rule priority, that payoff-intent-first beats voice cleverness, drove the biggest correction: the third stranger read found roughly 120 words of consequences before the first instruction, so the lead was reordered to give the instruction second and the consequences after it. It also caught a withheld-mystery construction about the undated deadline, now named as wrongful trading in the same sentence, and two unglossed terms, 'decision procedure' and 'statement of truth', both now explained at first use. The claim that the decision date can fall anywhere in the 14 days now shows its basis (the three-business-day minimum) rather than asserting it. Unevidenced 'directors tend to' framing cut. First draft of this redraft swung too far into third person and dropped 'you' to 1.5/1k against a floor of 8; direct address restored where the obligation is genuinely the reader's and kept impersonal for the liquidator's own duties, landing at 26.4/1k. Body-level we/our/us is 4.9/1k against the voice-engine minimum of 5.0; gate check 04 passes, and the practitioner voice is carried by method rather than padding (what we would want to see before advising on timing, what we most often see counted from the wrong document, what we ask about first when taking a case on). Rhythm cv 0.431, the strongest of any version. Protected sentence 'The honest question is whether that date has already passed' carried across intact. FAQ panel titles restored to single-backslash escaped form after I wrote them raw in the first cut of this redraft.
